cost_minimizing.opened_facilities: sorted list of 0-indexed facility IDs selected for opening
cost_minimizing.total_cost: total cost (facility opening + expected variable transport costs)
cost_minimizing.expected_transport_cost: probability-weighted average transport cost across all scenarios

risk_aware.opened_facilities: sorted list of 0-indexed facility IDs selected for opening
risk_aware.total_cost: total cost including facility opening, expected transport, and risk penalty
risk_aware.tail_risk_value: the average transport cost in the worst (1-confidence)% of scenarios, as measured by the risk-aware model
risk_aware.risk_threshold: the cost level at which scenarios begin to be considered worst-case

comparison.facilities_differ: boolean: do the two plans open different facility sets?
comparison.additional_facilities_in_risk_plan: list of facility IDs opened in risk-aware but not cost-minimizing
comparison.expected_cost_change_pct: percentage change in expected transport cost (risk-aware vs cost-minimizing)
comparison.tail_risk_change_pct: percentage change in tail risk (risk-aware vs cost-minimizing, negative means reduction)
